SHARED-F-1-S178.title: Tool Allowlist Schema and Contract Definition
SHARED-F-1-S178.description: Define and formalize the allowlist schema for tool routing, including tool names, associated Pydantic models, and permitted execution mappings to ensure strict contract enforcement.

SHARED-F-1-S179.title: FastAPI Endpoint Integration with Tool Router
SHARED-F-1-S179.description: Integrate the tool router into the FastAPI request handling flow, ensuring all incoming chat requests are processed through allowlist enforcement before any domain service execution.

SHARED-F-1-S180.title: End-to-End Tool Routing Integration with Chat Loop
SHARED-F-1-S180.description: Ensure the tool router is fully integrated into the Anthropic agentic loop, including chat history injection, tool call execution, and response propagation back to the user.

SHARED-F-1-S181.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Tool Router Enforcement
SHARED-F-1-S181.description: Expand test coverage to validate allowlist enforcement, schema validation failures, disallowed tool rejection, and successful routing across multiple tool scenarios.
